Economy · India

Indians selling gold jewelry amid price fluctuations

Reports indicate a significant increase in the sale of household gold jewelry in India. This trend appears to be driven by families selling old ornaments, possibly due to fears of further price drops after gold reached record highs. The sales volume has reportedly risen by 43% compared to the previous year.
